title: Fundo Mais
publisher: Ministerio da Familia, Inclusao e Desenvolvimento Social
why_not: undated programme page; it does state that RSI funds are deposited into beneficiaries' bank accounts, but the baseline slot went to Decreto-Lei 1/2026, which is dated, more authoritative and carries the same disbursement rail, and an undated page cannot serve a windowed progress slot

title: TEF - Transferencia Eletronica de Fundos
publisher: SISP - Sociedade Interbancaria e Sistemas de Pagamentos
why_not: describes the same electronic credit transfer rail as the SICIL baseline, from the operator rather than the regulator, and names the Direccao Geral do Tesouro as a participant; carries no date, so it can serve neither the single baseline slot nor a windowed progress slot

title: Diretrizes para a elaboracao da proposta do Orcamento do Estado para 2027
publisher: Ministerio das Financas / Governo de Cabo Verde
why_not: the 50000-character capture stops at the contents pages before section IV.3.1, so the fetched body does not contain the commitment to integrate the Vinti4 network into international payment systems and cut remittance fees that the lead was selected for; not staged on a claim the stored body cannot support

title: Boletim Oficial, II Serie - Aviso 5/2022, que regulamenta as condicoes de emissao, aceitacao e utilizacao de cartoes de pagamento
publisher: Banco de Cabo Verde - Boletim Oficial
why_not: the capture reaches the index and Aviso 4/2022 on opening payment accounts but truncates before the operative text of Aviso 5/2022, so the stored body does not carry the payment-card consumer rules; the baseline slot went instead to the Decreto-legislativo 8/2018 bulletin, whose text is held
